title: Fake Plastic Trees
feel: Quiet acoustic strum building to full band, about 74 bpm (estimate)

alt_voicings.label: Simpler chart
alt_voicings.note: plain F♯m, D and Bm for the colour chords

sections.name: Verse
sections.bars: A | % | % | Asus4 A | Dmaj9/F# | % | % | E | Dsus2 | A | Dsus2 | %
sections.note: Dmaj9/F♯ is the tab's “A/F♯”; the simple chart plays F♯m there.

sections.name: The turn
sections.note: Two to four times; ends A – Asus4 – A. The bridge alternates Bm and A three times.

why: One **2nd-fret partial shape over a moving bass** (A, F♯, B): the slash-chord idea, with E and A ringing on top.
hard_change: **A → thumb-over F♯ bass voicing** (Dmaj9/F♯). Bring the thumb over first, then drop the fingers.
theory: I–vi–V–IV in A. The colour voicings keep E and A ringing on top as pedal tones.
steps: Changes alone, slowly: A → Dmaj9/F♯ → E → Dsus2.
With the record; the full-band chorus repeats the same material louder.
caveat: The tabs label sections differently; these section names are a reconciliation. Voicings vary between transcriptions — trust your ear and your teacher's version.
